verdict.rationale: AutoGen documents installing via pip and running agents programmatically with `await agent.run(task=...)`. AutoGen Studio also lets you export teams to Python code and run them in a Docker container, so agents can run as headless scripts without the UI. The evidence never shows a terminal command or CLI for running the bundled example agents, nor a workflow for an agent to verify its own build output. missing for 10: documented CLI/terminal invocation of example agents, explicit headless/non-interactive run guidance, evidence of using runs for automated verification, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can run the framework's example agents headlessly from a terminal so an agent can verify what it just built
